newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Sichuan Chemical net lags turnover.
newsitem.headline: China Sichuan Chemical net lags turnover.

text.p: China's Sichuan Yinshan Chemical Industry (Group) Co Ltd on Friday said its net profit rose 2.2 percent to 17.59 million yuan in 1996 while turnover increased by 35.39 percent.
Yinshan's 1996 turnover was 179.63 million yuan compared with 132.67 million yuan in 1995, the company said in an annual report issued in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

Operating costs rose to 140.71 million yuan last year compared with 100.08 million in 1995. Yinshan produces sulphuric acid and other industrial chemicals, the report said. Company officials were not available to comment.
Accounts receivable rose to 33.43 million yuan at the end of 1996 from 7.89 million yuan at end-1995. Yinshan attributed this to a sluggish market.
Earnings per share rose to 0.34 yuan in 1996 from 0.33 yuan in the previous year.

The company, which listed 15 million A shares in Shenzhen last December, said it planned to dish out a 0.30 yuan cash dividend for each share, to be discussed at a shareholders' meeting. It did not say when the meeting would be held.
